description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git merge --abort' functionality under different scenarios. It sets up a repository with various branches and tests the behavior of aborting merges in multiple conflict and clean states, including index and worktree modifications.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Executes a test expecting success, runs a series of commands, and verifies the outcome.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used to verify negative test cases.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output, used for validating error messages.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specific file or directory does not exist.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual file contents.
